items.title: bank sync you can find
items.body: finance shows bank connections on its overview and when you have no accounts yet. plaid comes first with its sign-up steps, and it now links over the tailnet.

items.title: gmail in one tap
items.body: pick gmail in mail. after a one-time google setup that alles walks you through, signing in is one button.

items.title: copy that works
items.body: copy buttons work when alles is opened over plain http on your network, and vault copy works in safari.

items.title: the whole world in settings
items.body: region, time zone and currency list every option with a search, and setup lets you fix a wrongly guessed region. passwords need 8 characters.

items.title: calmer details
items.body: fields show focus on their own edge, hover never looks like a pick, drawers slide shut, letters jump through dropdowns, and search suggests a fix for typos.

items.title: text aide on telegram
items.body: make a bot with @BotFather, paste its token and send it a message. aide answers there, and approvals still happen inside alles.

items.title: mail that shows up fast
items.body: a new device shows the mail alles saved last right away, and the inbox overview starts on unread with one button to summarize all of it.

items.title: one-click installs
items.body: settings and setup list node, pi, aide's browser and searxng with their real state and an install button. setup ends with what to connect next.

items.title: small tools in search
items.body: andromeda answers tips, percentages, bmi, loans, number bases, roman numerals, unix time, passwords, encoding, word counts and the moon without anything leaving your machine.

items.title: easier to find
items.body: files lists your docs folder read-only, habit icons come from an emoji search, and each book has one want / reading / read row.

items.title: easier to read
items.body: text is bigger everywhere, and bigger again on an ipad or a phone. font size in settings → general still works on top of it.

items.title: touch scrolling that stays put
items.body: a swipe scrolls the part of the screen you touch, not the whole page, and scrolling back while Aide is still replying holds still until you return to the end.

items.title: image results in even rows
items.body: andromeda's images keep their shape and line up in rows like google images, with the site and title under each one.

items.title: andromeda in settings
items.body: andromeda's search and answer settings moved into the one settings page, under apps. its answer model is the same one models shows, so changing either changes both.

items.title: effort that fits the model
items.body: Aide's effort menu shows only the levels your model takes. automatic lets the model decide.

items.title: alles in your language
items.body: the whole app, manual included, now comes in français, español, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어 and العربية. pick one in settings → language & region.

items.title: totals in one currency
items.body: finance and subscriptions add everything up in your ledger currency. an amount with no rate is listed, not guessed, with a button to add the rate.

items.title: calendar files keep their times
items.body: a repeating event from another time zone now repeats in that zone, so it stays right when clocks change. importing the same file again replaces it instead of doubling it.

items.title: a tighter shell for Aide
items.body: Aide's shell, git and patch tools can only write inside the task's folder and its own temp folder, on macOS and linux.

items.title: commands in code
items.body: type / in Aide code to see every command. /context shows what fills pi's memory, /compact frees it up, /goal keeps pi working until something is done.

items.title: effort for pi
items.body: models that think get an effort control under the box. low answers fast; high thinks longer. a running chat switches right away.

items.title: hide keys from the model
items.body: wrap a key or password in two bars, like ||sk-…||, and pi uses it without ever seeing it.

items.title: text Aide from your phone
items.body: connect with Photon in settings and alles sets up iMessage and lets your number through. if Aide needs your ok, the text tells you.

items.title: buttons you can see
items.body: every button in settings has an outline now, so it doesn't read as plain text.
